title: 11 Best AI App Builders in 2026: Scientifically Tested and Ranked
summary: We scored eleven AI app builders across 7 criteria worth 70 points total. Every score checked against the vendor's own pricing pages, docs, and product pages, and manually tested.
body_markdown: It depends on the job, and each use case has its own rubric. Solo founders shipping an MVP should start with our ranking of the[best AI app builder for founders](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-for-founders) . Designers who care about design systems and visual editing can compare tools in the[designers study](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-for-designers) . Agencies handing apps to clients should read the[agency and dev shop comparison](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-for-agencies) , and ops teams replacing spreadsheets should read the[internal tools ranking](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-for-internal-tools) . If you are building a subscription product, the[SaaS founders report](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-saas-founders) covers billing and multi-tenancy, and the[marketplace builders guide](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-for-marketplaces) covers two-sided payments. Local businesses can see how the field scores in the[small business comparison](https://blink.new/blog/best-ai-app-builder-for-small-businesses) .
